newsitem.title: DENMARK: Foreign investors' share of Danish bonds rises.
newsitem.headline: Foreign investors' share of Danish bonds rises.

text.p: Foreign investors held 17.8 percent of Danish bonds in circulation in 1996, up marginally from 17.3 percent in the previous year, the Danish National Statistics Office said on Friday.
In 1994 the foreign share was only 13.7 percent, it said.
The office said that the total nominal value of Danish bonds at end-1996 was 1.691 billion crowns.
It said that foreign investment in Danish bonds totalled 21.6 billion crowns in 1996's fourth quarter, 7.7 percent up on the previous quarter.
